question: What was our net booked value in Q3 2026?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) AS net_booked_value_usd FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' AND booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30';

question: How much is booked for Q3 2026 delivery?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(amount), 0) AS net_booked_value_usd FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' AND delivery_month BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30';

question: How much open pipeline does each salesperson own?
sql: SELECT r.full_name AS salesperson, sum(o.amount) AS open_pipeline_usd FROM opportunities o JOIN sales_reps r ON r.rep_id = o.owner_rep_id WHERE o.stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY r.full_name ORDER BY open_pipeline_usd DESC;

question: Which clients spent less this quarter than last quarter?
sql: WITH q AS (SELECT o.account_id, sum(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30') AS q2, sum(b.amount) FILTER (WHERE b.booking_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30') AS q3 FROM bookings b JOIN opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id = b.opportunity_id WHERE b.status = 'active' GROUP BY o.account_id) SELECT a.account_name, COALESCE(q.q2, 0) AS last_quarter_booked, COALESCE(q.q3, 0) AS this_quarter_booked, COALESCE(q.q3, 0) - COALESCE(q.q2, 0) AS change FROM q JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = q.account_id WHERE COALESCE(q.q3, 0) < COALESCE(q.q2, 0) ORDER BY change;

question: Which advertising products have the most available inventory next month?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, i.total_placements AS total_placements, COALESCE(b.booked, 0) AS booked_placements, i.total_placements - COALESCE(b.booked, 0) AS available_placements FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, delivery_month, sum(placements) AS booked FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY product_id, delivery_month) b ON b.product_id = i.product_id AND b.delivery_month = i.inventory_month WHERE i.inventory_month = DATE '2026-10-01' ORDER BY available_placements DESC;

question: Which opportunities have had no activity for more than 30 days?

question: What was the sell-through rate by product in August 2026?
sql: SELECT p.product_name, i.total_placements AS total_placements, COALESCE(b.booked, 0) AS booked_placements, round(100.0 * COALESCE(b.booked, 0) / NULLIF(i.total_placements, 0), 1) AS sell_through_pct FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT product_id, delivery_month, sum(placements) AS booked FROM bookings WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY product_id, delivery_month) b ON b.product_id = i.product_id AND b.delivery_month = i.inventory_month WHERE i.inventory_month = DATE '2026-08-01' ORDER BY sell_through_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

question: How many stalled deals does each sales rep have?
